name: R045-encore-disable-speed-tie
why: Challenge 7, every Pokemon has IV 31. The opponent's Dewgong (set 488: Encore and Disable) has Speed 90; the player's Skarmory (set 482) also has Speed 90 and no Quick Claw. On turn 1 none of Skarmory's moves is disabled, so AI_CV_Encore (and AI_CV_Disable) reach if_target_faster and draw the tie roll.
